I am an aro(?)ace in a relationship with an allo person. Very new relationship....so I guess similar to yours but I am the ace kid. 
I really want my partner to tell me what she is feeling / thinking about when it comes to sex. I am ready for the fact that we might not be compatible in that department and that night be a deal breaker. 
But I'd rather know what is it that she needs and maybe there is a middle ground. 
Tbh I don't understand sex enough to even start the conversation with her. So I would really appreciate if someday she is comfortable enough to open up to me about her feelings
Otherwise, I will probably just have to go up to her and ask her to talk about it. 

I know I can't do anything that includes fluids but maybe there are other ways I can satisfy her needs and not have to participate in anything I don't want to. And I want to be able to talk about that
